selection.selectionRule: Rank answerable PeerQA papers, cap each source group, and exclude every paper in the original FAROS pilot before inspecting predictions.

protocolAmendments.reason: Before opening validation scores, replace two descriptive baseline names with the immutable method IDs emitted by their runners. No prompt, model, sample, threshold, repetition, budget, or analysis setting changed.
Before opening validation scores, declare an unequal-output full-audit analysis as an operational upper bound. The frozen Top-5 analysis remains the only fair method comparison.

primaryMetric: expert-question coverage after blind human annotation

secondaryOperationalAnalysis.name: ReviewX full-audit coverage upper bound
secondaryOperationalAnalysis.allowedUse: Characterize the high-recall audit workflow and the cost of presenting the complete local finding set.
secondaryOperationalAnalysis.prohibitedUse: Do not use this unequal-output analysis to claim method superiority.

analysisRule: Do not tune prompts, thresholds, ranking, or budgets after opening predictions from this split. Report all failures and confidence intervals.
reportingBoundary: Automatic alignment is a retrieval-oriented proxy for candidate generation, not expert recall or review correctness.
